bull.b: Consistent positive operating and free cash flow provides durable funding for R&D, capacity expansion, acquisitions and debt service. Strong cash conversion supports self‑funding of strategic initiatives and reduces reliance on external financing over the next several quarters.

bull.t: Data center and LoRa product momentum
bull.b: Broad-based design wins (800G/1.6T) and record data center shipments plus rising LoRa revenues indicate sustainable end-market traction. Diversified product wins across interconnect and IoT reduce single-market risk and underpin multi-quarter revenue upside as customers ramp production.

A new $360M revolver plus improving leverage (positive equity vs prior negative) materially raises liquidity and financial flexibility. This supports working capital, refinancing and targeted M&A while covenants impose discipline, strengthening medium‑term financial resilience.

bear.b: Ongoing GAAP net losses despite operating profitability limit free distribution to shareholders and can constrain long‑term capital allocation choices. Continued accounting losses may reflect past write‑downs and integration costs that could delay return of capital or buybacks.

A meaningful TTM revenue decline tempers confidence in top‑line durability; sustaining margins and funding higher R&D depends on reversing this trend. If revenue weakness persists it could erode pricing leverage and make R&D payback periods longer.

Severe GaN supply shortfalls can cap near‑term revenue growth, force lost sales or customer delays, and require significant capex and time to expand clean‑room capacity. Capacity bottlenecks risk margin dilution and customer churn if competitors supply constrained demand first.
